scope: Hardware ordering across Xbox command-list slot 67 with the existing indirect-dispatch control. Dependent GPU read/modify/write operations exercise the full address space, an allocated buffer range, a range starting at address zero, a zero-length range and a partial interval with the global mask. A CPU reference checks every output and guard word.
